source_row.english: There is no actual stage for those who die Before or together, for another body's been born. Because their goal's the same in a war or whatever, All possess it as much as the one who commits it.

spans.nul: Sentence-final declarative RO closes the proposition that another body has been born. English marks exactly this closure with the period after born and begins the next reason with Because.
